plugins.name: gauge
plugins.description: Band above the prompt: turn, output speed, turn and session cost, prompt cache countdown and context fill.

plugins.name: deck
plugins.description: A row per subagent and workflow agent, Pixel Clawd in a costume for its model, with running, finished and failed counts, time and a memory warning from 70% (/deck details adds cost, requests, tokens processed and memory), and a dithered progress band above the prompt while they run.

plugins.name: bulkhead
plugins.description: Guard for dangerous shell commands: blocks the catastrophic and stops the risky for a person to run or confirm.

plugins.name: livery
plugins.description: Conversation theme for the desktop app: a tinted reply with an accent strip, a blue prompt, code cards and tool rows colored by kind.
